AlternateTargets: to kill and to give life
Senses.Explanation: The paired words 'kill' (殺) and 'keep alive or give life' (活): killing and giving life. It appears with other paired Linji-house terms in the list 'killing and giving life, granting and taking, provisional and actual, illuminating and functioning' (殺活縱奪、權實照用). Fixed forms include 'free in killing and giving life' (殺活自在, 45 occurrences), 'killing or giving life according to the occasion' (殺活臨時), and 'killing and giving life at the same time or at different times' (殺活同時／殺活不同時). The record explicitly pairs it with the sword that kills a person (殺人刀) and the sword that gives a person life (活人劍): one turning word is the killing sword, one the life-giving sword, one kills and gives life at once, and one does so at different times (一轉語是殺人刀、一轉語是活人劍、一轉語殺活同時、一轉語殺活不同時). Another passage asks directly, 'What is killing?' (敢問如何是殺), and records Shiqi Tongyun responding by raising a foot. The headword occurs 1,275 times in 280 allowlisted texts, overwhelmingly in expositions and formula lists in later recorded sayings and lamp records. Juelang Daosheng also pairs unfettered killing and giving life with displaying a formal public scene, preserving the same two-way authority rather than introducing another sense.
Senses.Note: Corpus-wide vocabulary used especially in Linji-house descriptions, not an individual coinage. The curated passages are formula lists, a raised exchange, a proclamation, and preface prose; exact actor attribution follows the responsible person for each stored turn. Compare the killing sword (殺人刀), the life-giving sword (活人劍), and the parallel pair 'illuminating and functioning' (照用).

Occurrences.Kwic: 一轉語是殺人刀、一轉語是活人劍、一轉語殺活同時、一轉語殺活不同時
Occurrences.AttributionNote: The cited recorded-sayings collection (天岸昇禪師語錄), precept-giving hall address. Tian'an Sheng is the exact speaker of the stored four-turn formulation, distinguishing the killing knife, the life-giving sword, killing and giving life simultaneously, and killing and giving life at different times.

Occurrences.Kwic: 殺活縱奪、權實照用，一點也不曾欠缺
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Collected Old Cases Raised in the Lineage (宗門拈古彙集), Damei Fachang section. Baiyan Jingfu is the exact commentator who lists killing and giving life (殺活) with granting and taking (縱奪), provisional and actual (權實), and illuminating and functioning (照用); Baiyan Jingfu is not yet in the roster.

Occurrences.Kwic: 具殺活機，方能權衡佛祖
Occurrences.AttributionNote: The cited recorded-sayings collection (古雪哲禪師語錄), hall address at Guifeng Monastery. Guxue Zhenzhe is the exact speaker: he says only one with real conduct can benefit humans and celestials, and only one equipped with the mechanism of killing and giving life can weigh buddhas and patriarchs.

Occurrences.Kwic: 演唱宗乘，須具殺活縱奪。敢問如何是殺
Occurrences.AttributionNote: The Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Xuedou Shiqi (雪竇石奇禪師語錄), in Shiqi Tongyun's encounter record. An unnamed monk is the exact speaker saying that proclaiming the lineage requires killing, giving life, releasing, and taking away, then asking what killing is; Shiqi Tongyun answers by raising his right foot. The line, expanded context, section header, book title, TEI header, and corpus parallels do not name the monk.

Records of the Patriarchs Raising the Essential Principle (列祖提綱錄), Mi'an Xianjie's imperial-command hall address. Mi'an Xianjie is the exact speaker: he compares non-arising understanding to a royal sword whose killing and giving-life occur according to the moment.

Occurrences.Kwic: 全提其正令，殺活自在也
Occurrences.AttributionNote: The cited complete recorded-sayings collection (天界覺浪盛禪師全錄), Juelang Daosheng's preface to the Zunzheng Jian (尊正鑒序). Juelang Daosheng is the exact author: the piece belongs to the sequence of his own essays in juan 21, following his signed Zunzheng Gui preface, and the stored line describes wielding the true command with killing and giving life freely.

Occurrences.Kwic: 異類分披作戲場，縱橫殺活絕鋒芒；
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Juelang Daosheng (天界覺浪盛禪師語錄): Juelang Daosheng says that differentiated kinds spread out as a public scene while killing and giving life range freely without an edge.
